pages.title: Epsilon-Naught
pages.text: Omega to the omega to the omega, forever: the first ordinal that equals omega raised to itself. It is still countable, which feels absurd. The token has an endlessly recursive pattern, each layer like the last.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Raising omega to itself in the Ordinal Recursor, with power sets and ordinal shards, I reached a fixed point. Dark energy kept it from collapsing. I also found these in the Ordinal Spire.
